achievement_verify_email.name: Verify Email
achievement_verify_email.description: This achievement is awarded to players who’ve verified their email, locking in their identity and unlocking secure access. It’s a mark of readiness and reliability — the first step of every serious player.

achievement_verify_phone.name: Verify Phone
achievement_verify_phone.description: This achievement is awarded to players who’ve verified their phone number to stay informed and connected. It signals trust, engagement, and commitment to the game’s pulse.

achievement_add_desktop_app.name: Add to Homescreen
achievement_add_desktop_app.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have added our Telegram mini app to their home screen. Always within reach, this action shows true dedication - because real players keep the game close.

achievement_super_spreader.name: Super Spreader
achievement_super_spreader.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have successfully referred <0>{{count}} new users</0>. A true community builder, they expand the circle and bring new energy to the game. Their influence grows with every connection they make.

achievement_conquistador.name: Conquistador
achievement_conquistador.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have accomplished a total of <0>{{count}} quests</0>. Driven by determination and a thirst for victory, they conquer every challenge that comes their way — a true champion of the journey.

achievement_game_explorer.name: Game Explorer
achievement_game_explorer.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have tried <0>{{count}} different games</0>. Curious and adventurous, they venture across the platform, always eager to discover new ways to play and win.

achievement_card_shark.name: Card Shark
achievement_card_shark.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have wagered at least <0>{{amount}}</0> on card games, proving their resilience, strategy, and willingness to take risks. These high-stakes players have earned their place among the elite. The cards are in their hands, and the game is theirs to command

achievement_slotmaster.name: Slotmaster
achievement_slotmaster.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have wagered at least <0>{{amount}}</0> on slot games, proving their persistence, thrill-seeking spirit, and love for the spin. These dedicated players embrace the reels with confidence — luck may lead, but mastery keeps them in the game.

achievement_talkative.name: Talkative
achievement_talkative.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have spoken up <0>{{count}} times</0> in the chat room. Every message counts—you're taking the first step in becoming a true part of the conversation.

achievement_bet_count.name: Bet Count
achievement_bet_count.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have placed a total of <0>{{count}} bets</0>. A true believer in chance, their unwavering spirit keeps the game alive with every wager.

achievement_deposit_count.name: Deposit Count
achievement_deposit_count.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have made a total of <0>{{count}} deposits</0>. With a steady flow of credits and unwavering commitment, they’ve shown they’re not just players — they’re tycoons in the making.

achievement_change_avatar.name: Change Avatar
achievement_change_avatar.description: This achievement is awarded to players who personalize their profile by changing their avatar. A bold step toward standing out and owning your identity in the game.

achievement_set_username.name: Set Username
achievement_set_username.description: You’ve claimed your name — now the legend begins. This achievement honors those who carve out their space and make it official.

achievement_download_mobile_app.name: Download Mobile App
achievement_download_mobile_app.description: This badge goes to players who’ve taken the game with them. Downloading the app shows you’re not here to pause — you’re here to play anytime, anywhere.

achievement_wager_in_a_day_single_game.name: Max Wager in a Day Single Game
achievement_wager_in_a_day_single_game.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have wagered at least <0>{{amount}}</0> on a single game in a day. It recognizes those with unwavering focus, calculated strategy, and the courage to take bold risks. These elite players have mastered their game of choice — and they play to win.

achievement_slots_win_count.name: Slots Win Count
achievement_slots_win_count.description: This achievement is awarded to players who’ve secured <0>{{count}} wins</0> on slot games. With every spin, they defy the odds and celebrate victory after victory. Luck may start the game — but consistency makes them a champion.

achievement_slots_multiplier.name: Slots Multiplier
achievement_slots_multiplier.description: This achievement is awarded to players who have secured a <0>win with a {{count}}x multiplier</0> or more in a single slot spin. It honors those who chase greatness, embrace the thrill of high risk, and land extraordinary rewards. These are not ordinary players — they command the reels and rise above the rest.
